ld.description: Matcha isn't only for your morning latte. Its grassy, umami-rich character makes it a surprisingly brilliant cocktail ingredient.Join us for an evening of matcha-inspired cocktails, delicious treats and good company. We’ll be mixing things up with More Cha matcha, exploring 3–4 creative cocktails that showcase a different side of green tea, from fresh and refreshing to rich and unexpected.What to expect🍸 A tasting of 3–4 matcha-inspired cocktails🍡 A selection of matcha treats💬 A relaxed atmosphere to meet new people and enjoy something differentAnd when the workshop ends? The night is just getting started!Stick around after the cocktail tasting for our bar takeover with a DJ from 7PM onwards. Enjoy more drinks, great music and an easygoing evening with the Matcha Affair crowd. The bar takeover is open to everyone, no registration needed.A little drink with a bigger purpose 💚For every drink and cocktail sold, we’ll donate €0.50 to Hejmo, supporting a more connected city.Good to know4PM: A Matcha Affair: Tasting & Workshop (separate registration required)6PM: A Matcha Affair: Cocktail Tasting (registration required here)7PM onwards: A Matcha Affair: Cocktail Fundraiser with DJ, drinks and music at the bar (open to the public, more information here)Please let us know about any allergies when registering.Come for the cocktails, stay for the vibes! 💚
ld.name: A Matcha Affair: Cocktail Tasting

ld.description: Dark, raw & unapologetic comedy with Berlin’s Abi Mohanty. Uncomfortable truths, taboo topics & big laughs.Tough Titties isn't just another stand-up show. It's a night of uncomfortable truths wrapped in hilarious stories, sharp observations and the kind of jokes that make you laugh first — and question yourself later.Berlin-based comedian Abi Mohanty brings her signature blend of dark humour, satire and raw honesty to Karakas Comedy Club.Born in India and now based in Berlin, Abi explores the uncomfortable side of life with a wicked sense of humour. Her comedy takes on taboo subjects including religious dogma, restrictive upbringing, mental health, sexuality, identity, individual freedom and the strange realities of being an Ausländer in Europe.Abi has opened for some of the biggest names in European comedy, including Dragos, Mike Rice, Radu Isac and Netflix star Adrienne Iapalucci, as well as Abhishek Upmanyu.She has also made her mark on the London comedy circuit, winning multiple gong shows, including the coveted King Gong at The Comedy Store.Currently converting childhood trauma into jokes one show at a time, Abi has performed across Europe — usually in places where Ryanair goes.Her comedy is sharp, personal and deliberately uncomfortable. No easy stereotypes, no safe topics — just brutally honest stories turned into very good jokes.Come for the dark comedy. Stay for the chaos. And don't be surprised if you feel slightly guilty for laughing afterwards. Dark comedy. Raw honesty. Uncomfortable laughs. Zero apologies.  14 November · Karakas Comedy Club Kurfürstenstraße 9, Berlin 10785
ld.name: Abi Mohanty - Tough Ti**ies

ld.description: Kuck dir die Welt doch an: Alle gehn dumm. Smartphone-Zombies, emotionaler Leerstand, machtbesessene Despoten. Zeit für einen Reset – Fliegende Haie finden: Wenn schon dumm gehen, dann richtig! Ausrasten, durchtanzen und schweißnass Hymnen hinausschreien für eine bessere Welt.Unterdrückung von Frauen, mentale Gesundheit, sexuelle Unfreiheit – Haie reißen Wunden auf, denn wir haben keinen Bock, dass morgen noch alles so ist wie heute. Also Blutrausch an und die Issues zermahlen im Revolvergebiss. Dazu Bässe, die Beine wegreißen wie der Weiße Hai.Der Haie-Hyperpop ist seit der letzten Tour 2025 düsterer geworden, doch live energiegeladen wie eh und je: Instant wirst du hineingesogen in eine Artshow, die das Salzwasser aus deinen Poren drückt, bis sie dich als neuer Mensch wieder ausgespuckt. Durchgeschüttelt, wachgerüttelt, aber glücklich. Nur was blutet, kann auch hailen.
ld.name: FLIEGENDE HAIE - Alle gehn dumm-Tour

ld.description: HOUSE OF PRIDE 2027 | edition #s6xBERLIN’S QUEEREST MAIN PARTYJuly 24, 2027.  Berlin Pride hits its peak — and House of Pride takes over after the Parade.For one unforgettable night our multi-venue Ritter Butzke, AQUAHŌFE Berlin & Kreuzwerk transform into a massive queer playground in the heart of Berlin: seven areas, indoor & outdoor, packed with beats, 50+ performers & djs, wild energy and thousands of people coming together to celebrate exactly who they are.House of Pride is not just another party. It’s a statement. A celebration. A beautiful, sweaty, loud and unapologetic explosion of queer culture. The event supports Berlin Pride and a beneficial project every year! From house to techno, disco to pop, RnB, rave & to everything in between, expect a genre-hopping journey through some of Berlin’s most iconic spaces — with 50+ artists, spectacular performances and enough energy to carry you through 12+ hours of Pride night.Come for the music. Stay for the madness. Dance with strangers. Kiss whoever you want. Lose yourself in the crowd.No labels. No limits. No judgment. Just Pride.HOUSE OF PRIDE 2027July 24, 2027 | 21:00  7 AREAS · INDOOR & OUTDOOR 50+ ARTISTS · 5 GENRES 3,500+ PEOPLE · 12+ HOURS KREUZBERG · BERLINThe official Main Party of Berlin Pride | CSD Berlin 2027.Headliner & Line-Up: TBAThis is your Pride night. Make it c(o)unt.
